posts.name: Alima
posts.cooked: I won’t be able to attend SCT exam window 1 for python programming since the laptop i am using now will not be with me during OPPE 1. My new laptop will arrive before October 1 but after September 28. So i want to ask if I can’t be able to attend SCT window-1 exam, will I be still eligible for SCT window-2?

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked:
SCT is basically to check whether you know how to manage everything or no

So, use your old laptop or anyone else laptop and at the time of OPPE Use your New Laptop, just follow the rules & regulations shown in the Demo Video

posts.name: Alima
posts.cooked:
https://discourse.onlinedegree.iitm.ac.in/t/sct-related-doubts-t1-2025-post-here/164573?u=25f2008575

This post says we must give SCT window-2 if we change the device.

link_counts.title: SCT Related Doubts | T1- 2025 | Post Here

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked:
It is for another term not Window 2 because when your SCT is approved then you don’t get chance to do in Second Window and if you don’t do SCT in Window 1 then also you didn’t get any chance to do SCT in Second Window.

So, in your case just complete the SCT
because previously after doing SCT i changed my Laptop , changed my OS from windows to Linux and Changed my Location yet no problem in giving OPPE.

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked:
Instead of Thanks, Thank you or +1 use Like Button
and if you issue is resolved then mark the Solution on the Post by which your issue is re-solved.

posts.name: Dipanshu Ravi Shamkuwar
posts.cooked: Can I Use same phone for both hotshot for laptop and camera for gmeet, because in instructions it is saying to inform proctor and place phone used for hotshot in front of camera.

posts.name: BHAVEN
posts.cooked: You have to join the gmeet with your phone during the exam and not with your laptop as the exam portal will already monitor you via the laptop’s webcam. If you are using your phone’s hotspot for the exam then you have to prior inform the proctor about the same.

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked: No, you have to use separate Mobile for Hotspot and placed a place from where proctor able to see that phone.
